r0.why: Coefficients related to sums/products of roots (1); relations between roots without computing them (5).

r1.why: r1+r2=-b/a, r1r2=c/a (8); first equation finds minimum or maximum (9).

r2.why: Factorization into a0(x-r1)...(x-rn) (3), coefficients from roots (4), comparing powers gives the n=2 formulas (10).

r3.why: General formula and definition of elementary symmetric polynomial from 4; sum/pairs/alternating sign follows directly from the formula.

r4.why: Care needed outside integral domains (6); mod 8 example with four roots, two factorizations, not usable with 1 and 3 (7).

r5.why: Viete 16th-c French, Latin name (2,11), positive roots (11), close to al-Tusi 12th c (12), Girard first to understand coefficient formation (14).
